Appendix B. Detailed Regional Results The following sections provide detailed information on existing transmission cost allocation practices across RTOs and ISOs. B.1 CAISO CAISO defines three primary transmission planning project types in its regional planning process (reliability, economic, and public policy projects) (2023-2024 Transmission Plan 2024). However, CAISO has also stressed in formal reply comments in FERC proceedings that its iterative planning process allows for consideration of transmission projects with “multiple benefits streams (e.g., reliability, public policy, and economic)” (Reply Comments of the California Independent System Operator Corporation, n.d.). Therefore, CAISO may pursue forms of multivalue planning, even if multivalue projects are not explicitly defined as a regional transmission project type.
